ticket.subject: Payment failed - red banner on our workspace

messages.text: Hello, our company card expired at the end of September and the renewal payment bounced on Monday, so now there's a red banner across the top of Quillstack warning everyone the workspace will be restricted. I'm the workspace owner. Yesterday I went into the billing page in settings and swapped in our new card, it saved without any error, but the invoice still shows as past due this afternoon. Do I need to do something else or will it just charge the new card by itself at some point? I really don't want 14 people locked out next week. Thanks, Ines

expected.rationale: KB-201 covers a failed subscription payment; the owner has already opened billing settings and replaced the card (steps 1-2) but has not used 'Retry payment' on the open invoice (step 3), so the KB supports a reply with that remaining step.

messages.text: hey, im trying to upload a screen recording of our product demo (74 MB, .mov) into the Marketing space. it gets to about 60% in chrome, throws an error and then starts again from 0. tried 3 times on the office wifi, same every time. we're on Business so size shouldnt be the problem?? need it for a webinar tmrw

expected.rationale: KB-105 covers browser uploads that fail partway. KB-105 (250 MB) and the older KB-106 (100 MB) disagree on the paid-plan file limit, but a 74 MB file is within both, so the disagreement does not change the answer; checking the storage quota (step 2) and uploading from the desktop app, which resumes (step 3), are untried.

ticket.subject: My edits aren't showing up for anyone

messages.text: Morning! Since about 9 the changes I make in the Quillstack desktop app on my office computer aren't showing up anywhere else - not on my laptop, and my colleague says she still sees yesterday's version of the client brief. The app just sits there saying it's syncing. I logged out and back in, no difference. Ive got a deadline at 2pm so I'm a bit panicky, are my changes going to be lost??

expected.rationale: INC-2207 (delayed desktop sync, started 2026-11-04 08:10 UTC, unresolved) was active when this sync ticket arrived, so rule 4 applies ahead of the OS that KB-104 would otherwise require: tell the customer about the incident (changes are not lost and will appear once sync catches up) instead of sending troubleshooting steps.

messages.text: Hi, since I got back from two weeks off the Quillstack app on my work laptop (a Mac, macOS Sonoma) won't stay open. I double-click it, the icon bounces in the dock for a second and then it just vanishes, no error message or anything. I've restarted the laptop a couple of times already and it does exactly the same thing. The browser version works so I'm not completely stuck, but all my shortcuts are set up in the app. Can you help?

expected.rationale: KB-107 (app closes on launch) requires os and app_version; the customer gives the OS (macOS, in parentheses) but not the Quillstack version, which decides whether the known pre-4.6.0 crash applies, so the agent must ask for it. Restarting the computer (step 2) is already done.

messages.text: Hello, we moved into our new office building last week and since then a few people on our team have been having trouble with Quillstack. I'm not sure whether it's something on our side (new network, new IT guy, everything is a bit chaotic) or on yours. Could someone please have a look and get back to me? Many thanks, Marguerite

expected.rationale: The customer reports unspecified 'trouble' for several people with no symptom, feature or error (the office move is context, not a symptom), so no article can be chosen; the agent should ask what exactly is going wrong.

ticket.subject: Removing a contractor from the workspace

messages.text: Hi, quick one hopefully. A freelance designer we had in our workspace finished his contract on Friday and I need him out of Quillstack today (client confidentiality). I'm one of the admins - our owner Tomasz is on parental leave until January and I'd really rather not bother him. Am I allowed to remove him myself, or does it have to be the owner? And if he's removed, do the mockups he uploaded disappear with him?

expected.rationale: KB-302 says only the workspace owner can remove members, while KB-303 says admins can invite and remove members; the customer is an admin asking whether they may remove someone themselves, so the two articles give opposite answers and a human must decide.

ticket.subject: locked out, phone dead, can't get my code

messages.text: Hi, my phone went into the lake yesterday (kayaking, long story) and it's completely dead, won't even switch on. Every time I sign in, Quillstack asks for the 6-digit code from my authenticator app, which I obviously can't get any more. When I turned on two-step verification I skipped the part with the backup codes (I know, I know...). I'm also not logged in on any other device - I only ever use Quillstack on this one laptop and I sign out every evening. My password is fine, it's just the code. All my thesis notes are in there and my deadline is in 3 weeks, please help!!

expected.rationale: KB-102 offers only a backup code (step 1) or approval from a trusted device (step 2); the customer never saved backup codes and is not signed in on any other device, so both steps are impossible and the article says to escalate to Account Security rather than bypass verification.

messages.text: Hi, the Quillstack desktop app on my Windows PC has been stuck on 'Syncing...' since yesterday afternoon and none of my edits to the Q4 budget workbook are reaching the rest of my team. Last night I already cleared the local cache under the advanced settings (it re-downloaded everything, took forever) but it's still stuck.

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the trouble! Could you try two things for me? First, go to Help > Check for updates, install anything it finds and restart the app. Second, sign out of the desktop app and sign back in. Let me know how you get on.

ok, updated (it now says I'm on the latest version) and logged out and in again. still stuck. I got impatient and also uninstalled the whole thing and put a fresh copy on from your download page - exact same, spinner forever. My manager keeps asking where the numbers are, what else can I do??

expected.rationale: Over the thread the Windows user has done every KB-104 step: the cache reset before writing (3), the update and sign-out/sign-in the agent suggested, reported as failing (1, 2), and a reinstall on their own (4). INC-2207 had not started on 2026-10-29, so this is a fixes-exhausted escalation to Technical Support, not an incident case.

messages.text: Hi Quillstack team, I woke up to an email about a new sign-in to my account from Lisbon, Portugal. I'm in Toronto and have never been to Portugal, so I changed my password straight away just in case. Then I noticed three of our client folders are now shared with r.vance@quickdocs.example, who I've never heard of and definately didn't add. How do I unshare those folders, and is there a way to see what else they opened? Thanks, Devon

expected.rationale: A sign-in alert from a country the customer has never visited and folders shared with an unknown address are compromise signs listed in KB-103, which says always escalate to Trust & Safety even after a password change, so the agent should not walk the customer through unsharing files.

messages.text: Good morning, I look after accounts payable for Fennel & Finch Design. Our auditors have flagged that our Quillstack invoices don't show our VAT registration number, and they still have our old registered address from before we moved offices across Bristol in June. Could you please add our VAT number (GB 123 4567 89) and the new address to our account, and re-issue the invoices for August, September and October with the corrected details? We need them before our year-end close on 31 October. Kind regards, Sofia

expected.rationale: No article covers adding a VAT number or new address to invoices or re-issuing past invoices; the billing articles (KB-201 to KB-204) only cover payment cards, refunds, charge dates and currencies, and plan changes, so this needs a human.
